verdict.rationale: Plaid's testing docs describe a dedicated Sandbox mode for Identity Verification. It accepts a fixed set of test inputs that produce successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks, and it supports custom test users created directly in Sandbox, so testing doesn't require real user data. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on how Sandbox is isolated from production (separate keys or environments), coverage of failure and risk scenarios beyond the fixed success inputs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
